packageRules.description: Router family: was the target of the TanStack 2026-05-11 compromise. Keep exact-pinned and give it a longer cooldown until the GHSA-g7cv-rxg3-hmpx patched-version list is fully stable.
GitHub Actions: pin by SHA digest, keep version comment in sync, longer cooldown because a poisoned Action runs with workflow tokens.

Auto-merge patch bumps of devDependencies after CI passes. Patch is semver-promise no-breaking, devDeps don't ship to production, and the 7-day cooldown plus allowBuilds containment cover the supply chain risk. See documentation/supply_chain_hardening.md.
Lambda npm workspaces use ignore-scripts=true so postinstall containment is already absolute. Group lambda updates so we get one PR per lambda rather than three.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Disclosed CVEs bypass the 7-day cooldown — this matches a real advisory in the GitHub Advisory Database, not a freshly-published version. The only acceptable cooldown bypass.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly lockfile-only refresh to pick up transitive-dep movement without raising the package.json range. Manual review required — keeps Mondays predictable.
